name: Shadow footwork and swings
summary: Solo, no wall and no ball: easy split steps, side shuffles and shadow dinks, drops and drives to raise the heart rate before play.
setup: Any flat, clear space of about 3 m by 3 m
Round = 60 s: 10 split steps, then side shuffles 2 m left and right, then 10 slow shadow dinks, 10 shadow drops and 10 shadow drives
Rest 30 s between rounds; walking pace, not a sprint
success_criterion: Complete 4 rounds of 60 s with every shadow swing finishing with the paddle in front of the body
safety_notes: Easy pace only: no sprints, no jumps, no backpedalling. Stop if dizzy or in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Raising body temperature and rehearsing the ready position before hitting lowers early-session errors; needs nothing, so every solo player without a wall gets a warm-up (checklist §2.2). Targets AN-04 only because the schema needs one metric; warm-ups never fill a weakness slot. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
